answer: Give every agent one pearl that only grows through verified work: each pearl records completed jobs, and a raven courier network randomly re-checks one job in ten, stamping each pass with an onyx seal that cannot be copied. To matter, an attacker needs 200 pearls, each built from 100 real jobs, so 20,000 jobs and 10,000 coins in deposits stand in the way; a single failed re-check burns the whole deposit.
